title: Enumerate current context
command: az account show && az ad signed-in-user show
description: Confirms which subscription and identity your token maps to before you touch anything.
output: Subscription, tenant and the signed-in user object, your starting blast radius.

title: List readable resources
description: Everything your identity can see in the subscription. Roles decide what appears.
output: Resource names, groups and types you have at least Reader on.

title: Dump role assignments
description: Maps who has what across the subscription. Look for Owner/Contributor to abuse.
output: Principal, role and scope rows, the RBAC map for privilege-escalation paths.

title: Entra ID (Azure AD) recon
description: Pulls the full Entra ID directory into a local DB for offline analysis.
output: A local database of users, groups, apps and roles to explore with roadrecon gui.

title: Collect Azure attack paths
description: BloodHound collector for Azure. Reveals paths across identities and resources.
output: JSON for BloodHound to graph escalation paths through Azure RBAC and Entra roles.
